fusions.name: Paid-Out Thread
fusions.desc: Lashes a target up to 5 tiles away with thread. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt Unrolled
fusions.desc: Throws a bolt of cloth across a cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 13 damage and knocks each enemy back 2 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrice-Wound Wrap
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 3 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 6% while you carry it.

fusions.name: Rewinding Bobbin
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you recover 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
